name: Beast-Blooded Aasimar (Wildling Aasimar Variant)
source: Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse

body:
Not all aasimars trace their lineage to angels, agathions, and similar celestials.

Some are humanoids imbued with the very essence of the wilderness of the Upper planes themselves, or one of the many noble beasts that roam those celestial mountains, forests, and plains.

As a beast-blooded aasimar, your features resemble an animal, either subtly or overtly.

In addition, you gain the features below.

These features alter ability score modifiers and replace skilled and spell-like ability.

Core Traits
Ability Scores You gain +2 Dex, +2 Wis.
Wild Attack Traits You gain your choice of either two claw attacks or one bite attack. Regardless of your choice, these are primary natural attacks that deal 1d4 damage each.
Wild Magic Traits You can use guidance, light, and speak with animals once per day each as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level.
Wild Movement Select one of the options below at 1st level; once you have made this choice it cannot be changed. (Recommended animal types for each selection are listed in parentheses.)
Burrow (ant, armadillo, badger, rabbit): You have heavy, hooked claws ideally suited for digging. You gain a burrow speed of 20 feet.
Climb (bear, cat, lizard, mantis): Your lithe limbs and sharp nails make it easy for you to gain a foothold. You have a climb speed of 30 feet, and gain the +8 species bonus on Climb checks that a climb speed normally grants.
Glide (bat, bee, hawk, pterosaur): You take no damage from falling (as if subject to a constant non-magical feather fall spell). While in midair, you can move up to 5 feet in any horizontal direction for every 1 foot you fall, at a speed of 60 feet per round. You cannot gain height with your gliding wings alone; you merely coast in other directions as you fall. If subjected to a strong wind or any other effect that causes you to rise, you can take advantage of the updraft to increase the distance you can glide.
Run (antelope, dinosaur, dog, horse): You receive Run as a bonus feat and a +2 species bonus on initiative checks.
Swim (dolphin, fish, frog, shark): You have a swim speed of 30 feet and gain the +8 species bonus on Swim checks that a swim speed normally grants. In addition, you ca hold your breath for a number of rounds equal to four times your Constitution score before risking drowning or suffocating.
